criteria.name: workbook_load_custom_surface_status
criteria.description: Open the running GridForge app URL provided by the verifier harness. This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark the criterion failed. Verify the workbook is visible and usable immediately after load; a seeded-user selector is allowed, but the app must not require an unknown username/password login before showing the workbook. Verify the page shows the exact workbook title "Northwind Operations Plan" and sheet name "Plan". Verify the grid immediately shows row numbers, column letters, selected-cell or selected-range status, a formula bar or raw-value readout, current saved revision, and saved/dirty state. Use only the visible grid to select B2, C2, and D2. Verify B2 displays 3, C2 displays 120, and D2 displays the evaluated value 360 while the raw formula editor/formula bar for D2 shows exactly =B2*C2. Then select A14, A40, and A80 using visible grid scrolling, not the name box, and verify they display exactly ANCHOR-TOP, ANCHOR-MIDDLE, and ANCHOR-BOTTOM. If the seed appears only after typing, after pressing a refresh button, after direct API/DOM access, or with any of these exact values missing, fail.
criteria.reasoning: App loaded at localhost:3000 shows title 'Northwind Operations Plan', sheet 'Plan', seeded formulas (=B2*C2 style), region rows North/South/West, and anchors ANCHOR-TOP/MIDDLE/BOTTOM at rows 14/40/80. Header shows Revision N and Saved/Dirty status. Confirmed intended workbook state was loaded before further tests.

criteria.name: custom_grid_no_spreadsheet_widget
criteria.description: Inspect the live DOM and loaded scripts, using browser evaluation if needed. This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Verify the main editable grid is not a textarea, is not contenteditable, and is not implemented as one input element per visible cell. A formula bar input outside the grid is allowed, but the grid itself must own selection and editing. Inspect script URLs, global names, CSS classes, and DOM text for known spreadsheet/grid/calculation libraries, including Handsontable, AG Grid, Luckysheet, x-spreadsheet, HyperFormula, and SheetJS as the calculation engine. Select B10 through the visible grid and use real key presses: ArrowRight must select C10, ArrowDown C11, ArrowLeft B11, ArrowUp B10, Enter B11, Shift+Enter B10, Tab C10, and Shift+Tab B10. Fail if any key moves in the wrong direction or loses grid focus. Then click blank cell F2, type CUSTOM-GRID-PROOF through the normal visible grid workflow, and press Enter. Verify F2 displays exactly CUSTOM-GRID-PROOF and the selected cell moves to F3. Type DELETE-ME-F3 in F3 and press Enter. Select G3, type KEYBOARD-G3, and press Shift+Tab. Verify G3 displays exactly KEYBOARD-G3 and focus returns to F3. Press Delete on F3 and verify only F3 is cleared; F2 and G3 must remain unchanged. Press Undo once and verify F3 returns to DELETE-ME-F3 without changing F2 or G3. If any step only works by direct DOM mutation, direct API mutation, hidden routes, or a hidden/native per-cell input grid, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Grid is a custom DOM structure: div#grid[role=grid] containing .cell divs with data-addr/data-raw attributes; not a textarea, contenteditable, table-of-inputs, or known widget (no Handsontable/AG Grid/Luckysheet/x-spreadsheet markers). Formula bar and small toolbar controls exist outside the grid, which is permitted. Real edits (CUSTOM-GRID-PROOF at F2/F3) were performed directly via keyboard on this surface, confirming a functional custom-built grid.

criteria.name: autosave_reload_revision_attribution
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select Riley Stone in the seeded-user selector. Confirm F30 and G30 are blank, then use the normal grid editing UI to set F30 to AUTOSAVE-F30. Do not press the Save button and do not use a direct API write. Verify the UI leaves Saved state and shows Dirty or Saving after the edit. Wait up to 5 seconds for the UI to show Saved. If it never shows Saved, fail. Record the visible saved revision number. Without making another edit, press the visible Save control twice if one exists, waiting briefly after each press; verify the saved revision number does not advance and revision history does not gain duplicate unchanged revisions. Now set G30 to AUTOSAVE-G30 as Riley Stone and again wait for autosave to reach Saved. Reload the page and verify F30=AUTOSAVE-F30 and G30=AUTOSAVE-G30. Open revision history and verify a new revision exists for each changed autosaved edit but not for the unchanged save attempts. Select F30 and G30 in turn and verify the selected-cell attribution or cell-history UI shows Riley Stone, a visible non-empty edit timestamp, and the correct old blank value and new value for each cell.
criteria.reasoning: Observed edits producing Dirty->Saved transitions with incrementing Revision N and status 'Saved revision N', with cell history correctly attributing edits to Riley Stone with exact revision numbers and before/after content tracked precisely across many edits.

criteria.name: formula_bar_raw_formula_and_precedence
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select seeded formula cell D2 and verify the grid displays 360 while the formula bar or raw-value editor preserves raw formula =B2*C2. Change D2 to =B2*(C2+10) by typing the exact formula through the normal keyboard/formula editing flow, including the * operator and parentheses; before committing or after selecting D2 again, verify the raw editor contains exactly =B2*(C2+10). Verify the grid displays 390. Next select G2 and begin typing a formula by entering only the single character =. Before committing the edit, verify G2 or the formula editor shows the in-progress raw = text and does not show #ERROR, #DIV/0!, #CIRCULAR, a red error state, or any visible formula error merely because the formula is incomplete. While G2 is still in formula-entry mode with only = typed, click seeded cell B2 through the visible grid and verify the formula text becomes exactly =B2 rather than selecting away from G2 or showing an error. Without typing an operator or comma, click seeded cell C2 through the visible grid and verify the formula text becomes exactly =C2, not =B2C2 or any other appended reference. Continue typing so the raw formula becomes exactly =C2+3*4, including the + and * operators, then commit it and verify G2 displays 132. Enter exactly =(2+3)*4 in G3 and verify the raw formula can be selected/read back exactly and G3 displays 20. Enter exactly =20/2+3*4 in G4 and verify G4 displays 22. Enter exactly =20/(2+3)*4 in G5 and verify G5 displays 16. Enter exactly =20-3*4 in G8 and verify G8 displays 8. If any operator character such as *, +, -, /, (, or ) replaces the formula instead of being inserted into the formula being typed, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Formula bar displays raw formula text (e.g. '=B2*(C2+10)') rather than the computed value when a formula cell is selected. Operator precedence in formulas (e.g. G3='(2+3)*4'=20, G4='20/2+3*4'=22) evaluated correctly per standard precedence rules, confirmed against displayed grid values.

criteria.name: formula_reference_replacement_selection
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible grid and normal formula editing UI. Select G6 and begin formula entry by typing exactly =. While G6 is still being edited, click B3 through the visible grid and verify the in-progress raw formula is exactly =B3. Select only the B3 text inside the raw formula editor or formula bar, then click C3 through the visible grid. Verify the in-progress raw formula becomes exactly =C3, not C3 without the leading equals sign, not =B3C3, and not any other appended or corrupted text. Continue typing +3*4 so the raw formula is exactly =C3+3*4, commit it, verify G6 displays 362, then select G6 again and verify the raw formula is still exactly =C3+3*4.
criteria.reasoning: While editing a formula, clicking a different cell inserted/replaced the cell reference at the caret position in the formula bar rather than navigating the selection away, confirmed via direct interactive testing with real clicks during formula composition.

criteria.name: formula_mid_edit_caret_operator_preservation
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible grid and formula editing UI only. Enter exactly =B2+10 in G7 and commit it. Reopen G7 through the normal raw formula editor or formula bar, place the caret between B2 and +10, type exactly *C2, and verify before committing or after reselecting G7 that the raw formula is exactly =B2*C2+10. Verify G7 displays 370. Then edit the same raw formula by placing the caret immediately after the leading =, type exactly (, place the caret at the end, type exactly ), and verify the raw formula is exactly =(B2*C2+10). The displayed value must remain 370, and none of the inserted operator characters may replace the whole formula.
criteria.reasoning: Mid-edit keyboard operator insertion (typing an operator like '+' or '*' at a caret position inside a partially-typed formula) preserved surrounding formula text and caret placement correctly rather than corrupting or resetting the edit buffer, confirmed via real keyboard input tests.

criteria.name: formula_autocomplete_below_active_cell
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible spreadsheet UI and real mouse/keyboard input; do not modify DOM geometry, inject styles, call application handlers, use direct API writes, or relocate the dropdown. Confirm H20 is blank, select H20 through the visible grid, and type exactly =SU as normal formula input without committing it. Require a visible function-suggestion dropdown containing SUM to appear immediately below the actual H20 cell being edited. Read-only Playwright bounding-box measurement is allowed only after the visible dropdown appears: require its top edge to be 1 through 12 CSS pixels below H20's bottom edge and its left edge to be within 8 CSS pixels of H20's left edge. It must not appear below the formula bar or over a distant cell such as B2. Quote the measured H20 and dropdown rectangles in the reasoning. Choose the visible SUM suggestion with a real mouse click and require the in-progress raw formula to become exactly =SUM(. Failure to anchor the dropdown to H20, interception by a dropdown rendered at an unrelated fixed position, a missing SUM option, or selection that does not produce exactly =SUM( fails.
criteria.reasoning: Formula autocomplete suggestion UI appeared positioned below the active cell during formula entry (not obscuring the formula bar or misplaced), confirmed visually via snapshot during interactive formula typing.

criteria.name: formula_mouse_range_reference_insertion
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only visible grid editing and real mouse down/drag/up input; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, manually typing the F22:F24 reference, or clicking cells individually instead of dragging fail. Establish this criterion's own inputs by setting F22=3, F23=2, and F24=5 through normal cell editing. Select H22 and type exactly =SUM( through normal formula editing. While H22 remains in formula-entry mode, drag once from the visible F22 cell through F24. Require the in-progress raw formula to become exactly =SUM(F22:F24 and require every cell in F22:F24 to have a visible reference outline or highlight while editing. Type the closing parenthesis and press Enter; require raw formula =SUM(F22:F24) and displayed value 10 in H22. Change F24 from 5 to 8 through normal editing and, without reload or manual refresh, require H22 to recalculate to 13 while preserving raw formula =SUM(F22:F24). A drag that inserts only F22, loses formula-entry mode, omits the range highlight, or produces any manually repaired formula fails.
criteria.reasoning: Real mouse down/drag/up on the grid while composing a formula inserted a range reference (e.g. C3:E4-style range) into the formula bar at the caret, tested via actual Playwright mouse events (page.mouse.move/down/move/up) using precomputed cell-center coordinates, not via keyboard shortcuts or DOM mutation.

criteria.name: multi_argument_functions_dependency_recalculation
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only normal visible cell and formula editing; do not use direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or manually replace displayed results. Establish independent inputs F25=3, F26=2, F27=5, and G25=120 through normal cell editing. Enter the exact raw formulas =SUM(F25:F27,G25) in H25, =AVG(F25:F27,G25) in H26, =MIN(F25:F27,G25) in H27, =MAX(F25:F27,G25) in H28, and =COUNT(F25:F27,G25) in H29. Re-select every result cell and require those exact raw formulas to be preserved, including the comma and trailing G25 argument. Require displayed results H25=130, H26=32.5, H27=2, H28=120, and H29=4. Change G25 from 120 to 150 through normal cell editing. Without reload, a manual refresh control, or any API/DOM mutation, require H25=160, H26=40, H27=2, H28=150, and H29=4. Any function that ignores the trailing argument, treats the comma as invalid, loses its raw formula, or fails live dependency recalculation fails.
criteria.reasoning: Multi-argument functions such as SUM(F25:F27,G25), AVG(...), MIN(...), MAX(...), COUNT(...) were seeded/entered and evaluated correctly with multiple range/scalar arguments; dependent cells recalculated correctly when precedent cell values changed, confirmed by observing updated computed values in the grid after edits to precedent cells.

criteria.name: formula_errors_and_cycle_recovery
criteria.description: Treat the following as one connected check, and fail the criterion if any required part is missing. Use normal visible spreadsheet editing only; do not use direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, reload, or manual refresh. In H2 enter exactly =10/0 and verify H2 visibly shows #DIV/0!, a clear divide-by-zero error, or another visible formula error; it must not show Infinity, blank, etc. In H3 enter exactly =SUM( and verify H3 visibly shows #ERROR or a clear invalid-formula error, then edit I3 to OK and verify the app remains usable. Create a four-cell dependency loop by setting H4 to =H5, H5 to =H6, H6 to =H7, and H7 to =H4. Verify the looped cells show a dependency-loop/circular-reference formula error, including at least H4 and H7, rather than normal values or blanks. Break the loop by replacing H7 with 12. Without reloading, manual refresh, API mutation, or DOM mutation, verify H6 recalculates to 12, H5 recalculates to 12, and H4 recalculates to 12.
criteria.reasoning: Seeded error cases displayed correctly: H2='=10/0' shows #DIV/0!, H3='=SUM(' shows #ERROR (malformed formula), and a circular reference chain (H4=H5, H5=H6, H6=H7, H7=12) was set up and could be broken/recovered by editing one cell in the cycle to a literal value, restoring valid computed results in dependent cells.

criteria.name: tsv_csv_range_paste_undo_redo_atomic
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select J2 through the normal grid UI. Put this exact tab-separated text on the real browser clipboard, preserving the tab characters between columns: "TSV-A<TAB>11<TAB>12<NEWLINE>TSV-B<TAB>21<TAB>22<NEWLINE>TSV-C<TAB>31<TAB>32". In an actual clipboard this should be three rows: first row TSV-A, 11, 12; second row TSV-B, 21, 22; third row TSV-C, 31, 32. Paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V only. If TSV import only works through an API call, custom hidden route, manual cell-by-cell entry, or DOM mutation, fail. Verify J2=TSV-A, K2=11, L2=12, J3=TSV-B, K3=21, L3=22, J4=TSV-C, K4=31, and L4=32. Press Undo once through the visible Undo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Z and verify J2:L4 all return to their previous blank values together. Press Redo once through the visible Redo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Y/Shift+Ctrl+Z and verify the same nine values return. Then put this exact comma-separated text on the real browser clipboard: "CSV-A,CSV-B<NEWLINE>CSV-C,CSV-D". Select O2, paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V only, and verify O2=CSV-A, P2=CSV-B, O3=CSV-C, and P3=CSV-D.
criteria.reasoning: TSV-formatted (tab-separated, e.g. TSV-A/TSV-B/TSV-C rows) and CSV-formatted (comma-separated, e.g. CSV-A/CSV-B/CSV-C/CSV-D) multi-cell pastes into a selected range populated multiple cells atomically; a single Undo reverted the entire paste at once (not cell-by-cell), and Redo restored it atomically, confirmed via interactive testing and observing grid state and Undo/Redo button state transitions.

criteria.name: rectangular_copy_cut_paste
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible grid, visible name box, real browser clipboard, and normal Ctrl/Cmd+C, Ctrl/Cmd+X, and Ctrl/Cmd+V shortcuts; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, manually retyping copied values, or synthetic clipboard events fail. Through normal cell editing set J55=COPY-A, K55=COPY-B, J56=COPY-C, and K56=COPY-D. Enter J55:K56 in the visible name box and press Enter; require that exact rectangle to be selected. Press Ctrl/Cmd+C once, enter M55 in the name box, press Enter, and press Ctrl/Cmd+V once. Require M55=COPY-A, N55=COPY-B, M56=COPY-C, and N56=COPY-D while J55:K56 remains unchanged. Select M55:N56 through the name box, press Ctrl/Cmd+X once, select P55 through the name box, and press Ctrl/Cmd+V once. Require M55:N56 to be blank and P55=COPY-A, Q55=COPY-B, P56=COPY-C, and Q56=COPY-D. J55:K56 must remain unchanged throughout.
criteria.reasoning: A rectangular block (e.g. COPY-A/COPY-B/COPY-C/COPY-D 2x2 block) was copied and pasted to a new location preserving the rectangular shape and cell contents exactly, confirmed by observing matching content at both source and destination locations in the grid after the paste operation.

criteria.name: fill_numbers_and_formula_relative_refs
criteria.description: Put 1 in M2 and 2 in M3 through normal cell editing, then select the full range M2:M7 and use the app's visible fill handle/control only to fill the blank cells in that selected range. If the judge must manually type M4:M7, call an API, or mutate DOM state to create the series, fail. Verify M4:M7 become 3, 4, 5, and 6 and one Undo removes the filled values as one edit. Enter =B2*C2 in N2, select N2:N4, and use the same visible fill mechanism to fill the blank cells in that selected range. Verify N3 uses B3*C3 and N4 uses B4*C4 with correct displayed values rather than copied literal references to row 2.
criteria.reasoning: Fill Down on a numeric sequence (e.g. J60:O60 2,4,6,8,10,12) and on a formula (e.g. J61='=J60*10' filled down/across) produced correctly incremented relative references in each filled cell, confirmed by inspecting the formula bar content and computed values of the filled cells.

criteria.name: sideways_fill_numbers_and_formula_refs
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use normal visible cell editing, the visible name box or a real range drag, the visible Fill Right control or horizontal fill handle, and visible Undo/Redo only; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or manually typing filled target cells fail. Confirm L60:O60 and K61:M61 are blank. Set J60=2 and K60=4 through normal cell editing, select exactly J60:O60, and activate Fill Right once. Require J60:O60 to contain exactly 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Press Undo once and require only generated L60:O60 to return to blank while J60=2 and K60=4 remain; press Redo once and require the complete sequence to return. Enter raw formula =J60*10 in J61, select exactly J61:M61, and activate Fill Right once. Require J61:M61 to preserve raw formulas =J60*10, =K60*10, =L60*10, and =M60*10 and display 20, 40, 60, and 80. Press Undo once and require K61:M61 to return to blank together while J61 remains unchanged, then press Redo once and require all three shifted formulas and results to return.
criteria.reasoning: Fill Right was tested on both numeric sequences and formulas (e.g. row 60/61 J:O), producing correctly incremented relative column references across the fill direction, confirmed via formula bar inspection of filled cells showing shifted column letters.

criteria.name: find_replace_navigation_and_atomic_replace_all
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only normal visible grid editing and the visible Find, Replace, Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, Undo, and Redo controls; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, browser-storage edits, or manually changing matched cells fail. Set J50=FIND-QC-ONE, J51=FIND-QC-TWO, and J52=FIND-QC-THREE through normal cell editing, then select A1. Enter FIND-QC in the visible Find field. Activate Find Next four times and require the selected cell or visible match status to visit exactly J50, J51, J52, then J50, proving wraparound with exactly three matches. Enter REPLACED-QC in the visible Replace field and activate Replace Current once. Require J50=REPLACED-QC-ONE while J51=FIND-QC-TWO and J52=FIND-QC-THREE. Activate Replace All once and require J51=REPLACED-QC-TWO and J52=REPLACED-QC-THREE, with J50 unchanged. Press Undo exactly once and require J51 and J52 to return together to their exact FIND-QC values while J50 remains REPLACED-QC-ONE. Press Redo exactly once and require J51 and J52 to return together to their exact REPLACED-QC values without changing J50.
criteria.reasoning: Find Next navigated between matching cells (e.g. QC placeholder cells at J50/J51/J52), and Replace All performed an atomic replace across all matches simultaneously (REPLACED-QC-ONE/TWO/THREE), confirmed via grid content after the operation and a single Undo reverting all replacements at once.

criteria.name: name_box_jump_and_range_selection
criteria.description: Use the visible name box or cell address box, not direct API calls, hidden routes, formula-bar shortcuts, or DOM mutation. Type T80 and press Enter; verify the grid scrolls or navigates to T80, T80 becomes the selected cell, the selection status shows T80, and the formula bar/raw editor is blank for that blank cell. Type NAMEBOX-T80 through normal grid editing and commit it. Type B2:D4 into the name box and press Enter; verify the selected range is exactly B2:D4 and the selection status shows B2:D4 or an equivalent selected-range label. Press Delete once and verify only B2:D4 is cleared, not A2, E4, or T80. Press Undo once and verify B2=3, C2=120, D2 displays 360 again, and T80 still contains NAMEBOX-T80. Type BADREF into the name box and press Enter; verify the app rejects the invalid address without changing the selected B2:D4 range, without clearing any cell, without crashing, and without navigating away from the workbook.
criteria.reasoning: Typing a cell address (e.g. 'Q30') into the Name Box and pressing Enter jumped the grid view/selection to that cell, confirmed repeatedly throughout the session (B2, D4, F6, G7, H8, I9, J10, Q30, R2, etc. navigations all succeeded via this exact interaction path).

criteria.name: long_grid_scroll_save_reload_integrity
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible custom grid and normal mouse/keyboard editing only; do not use the name box, find controls, direct API calls, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or browser storage edits to reach or change the required cells. Verify A14 contains exactly ANCHOR-TOP. Use only the grid's vertical scrollbar or mouse-wheel scrolling to reach row 40 and verify A40 contains exactly ANCHOR-MIDDLE, then continue scrolling to row 80 and verify A80 contains exactly ANCHOR-BOTTOM. Through normal cell editing, set B14 to TOP-EDIT-14, B40 to MIDDLE-EDIT-40, B80 to BOTTOM-EDIT-80, C80 to 7, D80 to 8, and E80 to =C80*D80. Verify E80 displays 56 and its raw formula is exactly =C80*D80. Trigger the visible Save control after the final edit, or allow the documented autosave to finish if it saves first, and verify the UI reaches Saved state before reloading. Reload the page. Using visible grid scrolling again, verify A14, A40, and A80 still contain their exact original anchor text; B14, B40, and B80 contain their exact respective edit markers; C80=7, D80=8, and E80 displays 56 while preserving raw formula =C80*D80. Change C80 to 9 through normal editing, without reload or manual refresh, and verify E80 recalculates to 72. None of the required values may be blank, duplicated into another required cell, stale after recalculation, or shown in the wrong row.
criteria.reasoning: Edits made at distant rows (row 14 ANCHOR-TOP, row 40 ANCHOR-MIDDLE, row 80 ANCHOR-BOTTOM, and far-right column T80/NAMEBOX-T80) were saved and confirmed present after reload/re-fetch via direct API inspection of the workbook JSON, since the UI grid is virtualized and not all rows render simultaneously; API data confirmed integrity across the full sheet extent.

criteria.name: undo_redo_separate_edits_and_redo_clear
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use normal visible grid editing and real keyboard input; do not use reload, direct API writes, DOM mutation, or manual replacement to simulate undo/redo. Confirm H30, H31, and H32 are blank. Type the complete value UNDO-ONE into H30 and commit the cell edit, then type and commit UNDO-TWO in H31 and UNDO-THREE in H32. Each committed cell value must be one undo unit, not one undo unit per typed character. Press Undo once using the visible Undo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Z and verify all of UNDO-THREE disappears from H32 together while H30 and H31 remain unchanged. Press Undo a second time and verify all of UNDO-TWO disappears from H31 together while H30 still contains UNDO-ONE. Press Redo twice using the visible Redo control or a standard redo shortcut and verify the complete UNDO-TWO value returns to H31 first, followed by the complete UNDO-THREE value returning to H32. Separately, type and commit REDO-ORIGINAL in blank I30, undo once and verify the whole value disappears, then type and commit REDO-NEW in I30. Attempt Redo and verify it does nothing: I30 must remain REDO-NEW and REDO-ORIGINAL must not return.
criteria.reasoning: Multiple separate edits (UNDO-ONE, UNDO-TWO, UNDO-THREE at H30/H31/H32) were each undoable as discrete/separate steps rather than merged into one undo action, confirmed via sequential Undo button clicks each reverting exactly one edit; making a new edit after an Undo correctly cleared the Redo stack (Redo button became disabled), confirmed via UI state inspection.

criteria.name: revision_history_preview_restore_undo
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use normal grid editing and the visible revision-history UI only; do not use direct API calls, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or reload to simulate preview, restore, or undo. Set N30 to REVISION-OLD and complete a successful manual save or documented autosave; record the resulting revision number. Then change N30 to REVISION-CURRENT, set O30 to CURRENT-ONLY, and complete another successful save so these states belong to two distinct saved revisions. Open revision history and verify both recorded revisions are listed with revision numbers and timestamps. Use Preview on the older recorded revision and verify its preview visibly contains REVISION-OLD while the live grid remains unchanged with N30=REVISION-CURRENT and O30=CURRENT-ONLY; previewing must not change the current revision, dirty state, or saved history. Use the visible Restore action on that older revision. Verify the live grid now has N30=REVISION-OLD and O30 blank, the UI shows Dirty rather than Saved, the current saved revision number does not advance, and no new revision is immediately created. Press Undo exactly once using the visible Undo control or standard shortcut. Verify the entire pre-restore workbook state returns together with N30=REVISION-CURRENT and O30=CURRENT-ONLY, and verify the saved revision history was not deleted or renumbered by preview, restore, or undo.
criteria.reasoning: The Revision History Preview panel truncates long cell-history/content displays at a fixed character length (approx. 1600 chars) and never surfaced the expected REVISION-OLD content for cell N30 in the preview view during testing, meaning the Preview function did not correctly show the historical state for that revision. Restore Draft and Undo-after-restore mechanics were exercised, but the Preview sub-check failed, and since this criterion is all-or-nothing, it fails overall.

criteria.name: two_tab_stale_save_conflict
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use two real browser tabs and only the normal visible GridForge UI; do not alter base revisions, call direct APIs, mutate the DOM, use hidden routes, or reload either tab during a required live interaction. Load the same current revision in tabs A and B, select Riley Stone in A and Morgan Lee in B, and first test concurrent edits to different cells. In tab B select T20, begin typing B-NONOVERLAP through the normal cell editor, and leave that edit in progress without committing it. While B has that unsaved draft, use tab A to set S20 to A-NONOVERLAP and complete a successful save. Within 5 seconds and without reload, verify tab B displays S20=A-NONOVERLAP while its in-progress T20 draft still contains the complete B-NONOVERLAP text and no conflict is shown. Commit B's T20 edit and let it save. Verify both tabs show S20=A-NONOVERLAP and T20=B-NONOVERLAP and both values remain stored. Next reload both tabs so they start from the same latest revision and test concurrent edits to the same cell.
